ValidationRule.description: Account Segment field to be locked if set to MidMarket, unless the user can update the MidMarket National Account field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.MidMarket_National_Account_edit_permissions ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Account_Segment__c ) , ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( NSP_Account_Segment__c ) , 'MidMarket' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to take that action on this record.
